name: individual-ml1m
_hybrid_fitted_note: Weights from scripts/sweep_weights.py, grid-searched on a validation split nested inside the training data. The sweep never saw this test split. It assigned content-knn and popularity zero weight in all of its top 8 results.
_note: MovieLens-1M, the most reported benchmark in the field, as a second target so one table is comparable to published work. Absolute values still are not directly comparable to any given paper without matching its binarisation and split -- ours is ratings>=4 with a time-ordered leave-last-5-out.
